statement: Sailing was fixed so you can no longer get an abundance of chests.
The sailing artifact will now actually have some use after the fix.
Autocast for pet battles was added; pets cast abilities as soon as they are available.
You can set autocast so it doesn't cast abilities only before you start the arena; wording is garbled.
Auto spend for anvil points was added; click and hold instead of spam pressing.
You can hold down Craft from Storage in the anvil to make items like icing iron bites and saucy log fries easily.
A new World 3 shop item the Whetstone resets anvil points so you can juice anvil speed.
You can only buy one Whetstone per day.
He says the Whetstone was long needed.
Garbled mention of plus one to something ('slap oval') alongside the Whetstone.
Opal UI was remastered; you can swap opals across all characters in one menu instead of per character.
Quick ref now lets you set star signs and change opals from the menu without leaving the map.
Quick ref lets you upgrade alchemy bubbles and apply big bubbles from the menu without leaving the map.
He calls the quick ref a massive quality of life improvement.
The limited time shop has a new rotation with a new item type called hyperopals.
Hyperopals include best drop rate opals and multi-kill per tier; also all stat percent and total damage per set.
Hyperopals are equipped in the circle slot.
Hyperopals cannot be upgraded but can be re-rolled to plus one stats.
He thinks hyperopals are insane compared to the respective upgrades.
Another RNG chance in the limited shop is rolling for one of the wings in the game.
He got lucky and rolled another pair of angel wings and some 72 hour candy.
He rates the limited time shop rotation 11 out of 10.
Divine Knight's Orb of Remembrance gives 1% XP and 1% drop rate per mob kill while the orb is active.
His highest orb run was 566 kills giving 5.66x drop rate and 5.66x XP.
The orb bonus is not kept after it ends.
The orb is only for active play.
The orb counts base kills per kill; multi-kill doesn't work for it.
King of the Remembered gives printer output percent based on how many kills you get while the orb is active.
The King of the Remembered buff is permanent and based on power of ten tiers: 10; 100; 1000; 10000.
King of the Remembered printer output doesn't count with the atom collider; the collider is specifically materials.
Printer output percent is a multiplier that increases print size not printer sample so no need to resample.
Actively farming Divine Knight will be a must for big prints.
Divine intervention respawns all mobs on the map if all the mobs are dead.
Divine intervention has about a 2.2 to 3.2 second respawn delay.
The delay might be buffed later to 1.5 to 2.2 seconds.
Crystal spawn chance is still viable with Divine Knight because divine intervention doesn't count crystals to proc.
Knightly disciple and imbued shockwave have no damage increases; they scale off your Shockwave Slash ability in the Squire tab.
To scale their damage and mob hits level up Shockwave Slash for more DPS.
Knightly disciple places a statue on the ground that does a shockwave or big turret-like damage.
Imbued shockwave gives your auto attacks a chance to cast a Shockwave Slash and makes clearing maps easy.
Mega boomerang increases daggerang's mob max hit and its size; it gets a ridiculous size and can wipe the map.
Bitty litty talent may be a shout out to the community; Lava may have confirmed it.
He likes Divine Knight as an active-play choice alongside bubo; the community wanted choice rather than a class that is better than bubo.
Best map he found when testing for orb kills is the Citrus map at OJ Bay.
Alternative flat maps for the orb: the clammy map; chalkies map; deadday ramps map; or the snelby map in world 2.
Divine Knight wants flat easy maps for shockwave to juice orb kills.
Divine Knight works better in low mob density maps like wood mushrooms or blood boats; good for farming death note for those creatures.
Divine Knight is very beginner friendly and performs with very little investment compared to bubo which takes much more to become good.
Divine Knight is now top of the list in party dungeons at S plus tier; a video on it is coming.
He hopes Lava makes siege breaker an active-play class the same way as Divine Knight to give more choice.
He says Hunter as the Archer active class has little that truly benefits it except for urar which doesn't help with skilling.
Hunter's forging speed talent for smelting is one active benefit but siege breaker has it too; he'd prefer siege breaker with active abilities.
